remarks: The home offers endless potential for investors, builders, or DIY enthusiasts. With a newer roof, newer plumbing, newer siding, and an on-demand boiler, the major updates have already been done, but the home still needs TLC to make it shine. Sited on a generous .133-acre lot in an R-6 Zone. Just a short walk to the Metro North train station and with easy access to I-95, this location is perfect for commuters. Enjoy the vibrant downtown Byram area with its shopping, fabulous restaurants, and attractions like the beautiful Byram Park, offering a playground, marina, beach, and town pool. Whether you're looking to restore the existing structure or tear down and build something new, this is a fantastic opportunity to invest in a prime location in a growing community.
